steps.claim: Euskadi Física fell 1.48 points; the new competency model is to blame.
steps.fate: overturned at step 2: six of nine communities rose in 2026 under the same model

steps.claim: The 2026 fall is regional, not national. H1 survives only as a description of 2025.
steps.fate: the finding stands; its premise — that 2025 was a national collapse — does not, and is overturned at step 6

steps.claim: Canarias 2026 sits on the historical locus: the whole distribution moved down.
steps.fate: weakened at steps 4 and 5

steps.claim: Only 2 of 187 region-years sit below mean 4.5; the locus there is extrapolated.
steps.fate: the claim of step 3 becomes 'consistent with', not 'demonstrated'

steps.claim: The pass rate is normal; the 8–10 share is not, so its SD units are not calibrated.
steps.fate: top-band residuals are directional only

steps.claim: 2020–24 was a plateau, not a decline; 2025 returned to the 2015–19 norm.
steps.fate: reverses the sign of the national story and enlarges the Basque one

steps.claim: Among passers, the top-band share: the one measure least dominated by the level.
steps.fate: strengthens step 3; its two further claims — a plateau that reshaped, and a Basque turn in 2024 — were withdrawn at step 13, and the second was reinstated in a different form at step 14

steps.step: 8. Testing the slow version of H4
steps.claim: Do cohorts arrive less prepared each year? Not detectably — take-up is flat.
steps.fate: kills the recruitment mechanism, and corrects a dilution effect this study had itself reported from a phase-undercount of 2015–16

steps.claim: PISA 2006–2022: Basque science goes from +9 above Spain to −5, breaking in 2015.
steps.fate: the drift is real and pre-pandemic, but the cohorts do not match the PAU (1 of 3), which retracts the triangulation step 9 first claimed

steps.claim: On one scale, all four series fall; Euskadi is 1.7x Spain on BOTH instruments.
steps.fate: on 2012–22 every interval includes zero; with PISA 2025 the PISA slopes are significant and the ratio is 2.1 — the records are steps, not slopes (step 13)

steps.claim: Basque science falls to 458.5; top performers halve. Cohort term: −0.36 marks.
steps.fate: the two-year band of year-to-year variation is 6.5x larger, so 2027 is a policy outcome, not a prediction — the estimator's value is attribution after the fact

steps.claim: Paper length vs grade change: r = −0.84, p = 0.008 — the strongest link yet.
steps.fate: but length and competency content correlate at +0.79, so it is a better instrument for the same change, not a second cause; the Madrid count was 70 % solutions — corrected at step 13 (r = −0.905). The length is real; step 20 overturned what the dossier said CAUSED it

steps.claim: Re-run everything, second-code the papers, recompute every number, read the logic.
steps.fate: withdrew the plateau reshaping (a level effect), the Basque 2024 signal (5 of 17 communities show it), the slope agreement (stale window); fixed the 2027 proration and the Madrid count; found the plateau in every subject

steps.step: 14. The second audit (20 Sep) and the decomposition
steps.claim: Re-audit everything again; then ask what the fall is MADE of, not how large it is.
steps.fate: found 2024: a shape step (top band −5.9 pp off the locus, pass rate +5.0) invisible to every mean-based test, second-most-negative of 170 transitions; and split 2026 into a common part (+0.17), a quantified Basque part (−0.31) and −1.33 that no published data can yet attribute

steps.step: 15. Four objections from the coordinator (20 Sep)
steps.claim: Why the Spanish field? Were the nine exams comparable? Is the marking stricter?
steps.fate: the subject panel splits the Basque-specific fall exactly: −1.18 moved all of Euskadi's quantitative subjects together, −1.10 is Física's own. A general marking severity is bounded at a fifth of the fall; a severity confined to the numerical deductions fits and is confounded with the format change. No cohort rate can be projected: PISA is steps, not a slope

steps.step: 16. The statement, item by item (20 Sep)
steps.claim: Where is the reading, and what would a word budget cost the 2027 paper?
steps.fate: the length lives in the competency items in BOTH years (2025 A1 403 of 1026; 2026 A1 289 and B1 406 of 1431), and a competency item costs about 400 words in its first year and 300 in its second, so the 250 wanted for 2027 continues a trajectory the papers already show. One of the three competency elements of B1 is a transversal criterion printed on purpose, not a competence

steps.step: 17. The coordinator's corrections, and the marking regime (20 Sep)
steps.claim: What changed in the marking was non-award becoming deduction. Can that make 2026?
steps.fate: the 2025 distribution put through the 2026 regime — twelve deductions of 0.10 per script and a grave error in one script in six voiding most of it — reproduces all four published 2026 figures at once (mean 4.11 / 3.99, pass 39.0 / 39.8, at-or-below-2 25.2 / 24.5, zero 3.5 / 3.2). The deduction channel alone produces almost no zeros; a uniformly harder paper fits far worse (7.8 per cent at zero), so the regime is shown sufficient, not identified

steps.step: 18. How the penalties are spread (20 Sep)
steps.claim: Every candidate the same twelve deductions? What does a distribution cost?
steps.fate: a deduction removes 0.10 only where 0.10 is left, so the floor eats penalties aimed low (r = -0.99). Flat is therefore a CEILING over every reading in which the weak collect more than their share: the regime carries 87 per cent of the Fisica-specific -1.10 read flat, 81 to 59 as a distribution. It also CORRECTED step 17's top-band claim

steps.step: 19. What the paper is made of (20 Sep)
steps.claim: Can every sub-task lose a unit? Is the third channel really unmodelled?
steps.fate: only 14 to 19 of a script's 27 to 32 sub-items can attract a unit, prefix or rounding error, so twelve deductions are 0.67 penalties on every NUMERICAL answer and the whole fall would take 1.26. The linguistic channel is CAPPED at 1.00 by the criteria table the dossier already held: the thrice-repeated claim that it understated the regime is withdrawn

steps.step: 20. Where the reading load came from (20 Sep)
steps.claim: The 0.25 itemisation was a decision. What did it cost?
steps.fate: it OVERTURNS step 12's attribution. Per printed statement the competency narrative is UNCHANGED (71 words against 70) while demand text more than doubled (88 against 181) and printed prices went 0 to 17: the length is the price of the ITEMISATION, not of the competency reform. The two causes are differently actionable, which is why it matters
